shortDescription: Singapore Prime Minister Lawrence Wong pledged more support for workers and households and said the government would step up efforts to secure energy supplies and attract investment as the city-state confronts growing global uncertainty, according to Bloomberg.

title: Singapore’s Wong Pledges More Worker Support, Energy-Security Efforts
